name: QDrive
description: Build a quantum circuit by specifying target expectation values instead of gates.

output_files.name: circuit
output_files.description: The final circuit (QASM3), also chainable into a later job's initial_circuit via job:<id>/circuit.

ansatz.description: QASM3 ansatz circuits keyed by the number of qubits they act on.
ansatz.title: Ansatz

machine.description: Backend to run on; see backend.MACHINES
machine.title: Machine

n_qubits.description: Number of qubits in the circuit; required unless the initial_circuit file input is given
n_qubits.title: N Qubits

sample.description: Also run a shot-based sampler on the final circuit
sample.title: Sample

seed.description: RNG seed; a random one is drawn if omitted
seed.title: Seed

shots.description: Shot count used by both the estimator and the sampler
shots.title: Shots

targets.description: Ordered QDrive.target() calls; an empty/null entry calls update() instead. An expvals value may be a number, [value, certainty], or a measured[...]-style expression [[word, qubits, coefficient], ...] (optionally [terms, certainty]).
targets.title: Targets

code_samples.source:
import json
import requests

# First job: no initial_circuit, just n_qubits + targets.
r = requests.post(
    "https://api.mothquantum.com/v1/generation/qdrive-api-v1/process",
    headers={"Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_KEY"},
    data={"_params": json.dumps({"n_qubits": 2, "targets": [{"expvals": {"ZZ": 1.0}, "qubits": [0, 1]}]})},
)
job_id = r.json()["job_id"]

# Chain a second job off the first one's circuit, by reference — no re-upload.
r = requests.post(
    "https://api.mothquantum.com/v1/generation/qdrive-api-v1/process",
    headers={"Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_KEY"},
    data={"initial_circuit": f"job:{job_id}/circuit", "_params": json.dumps({"tomography": 2})},
)
print(r.json()["job_id"])

error_codes.description: params fail Params' own field validation (type/range).
n_qubits disagrees with initial_circuit's own qubit count.
coupling_map isn't a list of 2-qubit edges.
coupling_map references more qubits than n_qubits.
an ansatz key isn't an integer qubit count.
an ansatz value isn't parseable QASM3.
an ansatz circuit's qubit count doesn't match its key.
a target dict carries its own 'ansatz' key, which isn't supported — use the top-level ansatz parameter.
a target is missing 'qubits', has duplicate/out-of-range qubits, or a non-mapping 'expvals'.
update_method isn't one of spectral, direct, or constrained.
machine isn't a backend.get_backend() knows about.
